learningObjectives: Explain the structure and characteristics of MongoDB documents and collections.
Design document models for common application requirements.
Choose appropriate embedding and referencing strategies.

activities.title: MongoDB Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the hierarchy from a MongoDB database to individual document fields.

content.concept: MongoDB organizes data into databases, collections, and documents. Documents contain fields and values in a flexible JSON-like structure.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Container that holds collections and related application data.
Group of MongoDB documents representing a particular type of resource.
A single record stored as a BSON document.
A named property inside a document.
The data stored in a field, such as a string, number, array, or object.

activities.title: NoSQL Modeling Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the document design that best fits the access pattern.

content.concept: MongoDB data models should be designed around how an application reads and updates data rather than simply copying relational table structures.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Frequently accessed small profile details → Keep them together in one document
Frequently accessed small profile details → Always split every field into separate documents
config.answer: Frequently accessed small profile details → Keep them together in one document

activities.title: Embedding vs Referencing
activities.instruction: Choose the modeling strategy that best fits each relationship.

content.concept: Embedding stores related data inside the parent document, while referencing stores related documents separately and connects them through identifiers.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: A user has a small set of addresses always loaded with the user → Embed
A product has thousands of reviews that are queried independently → Reference
config.answer: A user has a small set of addresses always loaded with the user → Embed

activities.title: Document Model Builder
activities.instruction: Build a MongoDB document model for a user profile.

content.concept: A practical MongoDB document model organizes fields and relationships around application access patterns and expected queries.
